name: M.K.Sons Fine Jewels
summary: M.K.Sons Fine Jewels retails gold, diamond and CZ jewellery through five showrooms in Mumbai and Ahmedabad, sourcing all its products from third-party manufacturers and karigars; the Ahmedabad showrooms brought in about 68% of FY26 revenue. Revenue grew from ₹217 cr in FY24 to ₹539 cr in FY26 and profit rose 123% in FY26 to ₹51.8 cr, with the net margin widening to 9.6%. Operating cash flow was negative in FY24, FY25 and the June 2026 quarter and only ₹15.4 cr in FY26, as inventory days rose to 193. About 69% of the ₹220 cr fresh issue funds inventory for a new and an expanded showroom, and at the upper band the post-issue P/E of about 17.6x is below the median of the listed peers named in the RHP.

drivers.name: Subscription demand
drivers.detail: Subscribed 1.18x overall and 0.99x by QIBs (bidding still open).

drivers.name: Profit growth (RHP)
drivers.detail: Profit after tax grew 122.3% in the latest year in the RHP.

drivers.name: All 33 checks
drivers.detail: Financial health, governance, issue structure, use of proceeds, legal and risk checks.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹217.3 cr (FY24) to ₹538.7 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 57.4%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹217 cr, ₹351 cr, ₹539 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.39 at June 2026 (borrowings ₹70.5 cr vs net worth ₹183.0 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose 77% (₹38.6 cr to ₹68.4 cr) while total income rose 148% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹22.3 cr, ₹116.2 cr, ₹168.0 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹15.4 cr in FY26, about 30% of the ₹51.8 cr profit, after negative flows in FY24 and FY25.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew about 123% in FY26, to ₹51.8 cr from ₹23.3 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from 3.76% (FY24) to 6.62% (FY25) and 9.61% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 30.83% in FY26.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 39.88% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 17.6x (₹912 cr market cap on FY26 profit) vs a peer median of 21.9x (Senco 9.6x, TBZ 19.6x, PNGS Reva 24.2x, Motisons 27.8x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.26x (₹912 cr market cap vs about ₹403 cr post-issue net worth) vs a peer median of 3.9x.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer market cap to sales figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: Only bonus issues (May and December 2025) were found; no priced share issues or transfers in the 12 months before the IPO were found in public sources.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters hold about 69.8% after the issue, down from 100%.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The offer for sale is ₹55.08 cr, or 20% of the ₹275.4 cr issue.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The issue is about 30.2% of the ₹912 cr post-issue market cap.

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: The promoter selling shareholder's average cost is ₹18.31 a share, so the upper band is about 8.8x cost.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: ₹152.84 cr, or 69.4% of the fresh issue, funds inventory for a new Maharashtra showroom and an expanded Gujarat showroom.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: ₹30 cr, or 13.6% of the fresh issue, goes to repaying borrowings.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: General corporate purposes take ₹37.48 cr, or 17.0% of the fresh issue.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: Public sources don't say whose loans are being repaid.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: Litigation amounts were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: No information on criminal or regulatory cases was found.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: Contingent liabilities were ₹5.0 cr at June 2026, about 2.7% of the ₹183 cr net worth.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: All revenue comes from walk-in sales at its own showrooms; the concentration called out is geographic (Ahmedabad showrooms 67.97% of FY26 revenue), not by customer.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: It relies entirely on third-party manufacturers and karigars with no long-term contracts, which is called out as a risk; supplier shares are not published.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: Operating since 2012 (about 14 years), and the promoter has run the jewellery business since 1999.

checks.name: Auditor remarks
checks.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
